name: IASM – AI Search Visibility Monitor
author: mediterraneaservices

sections.description:
IASM – AI Search Visibility Monitor helps you understand how AI systems and AI-powered search engines see your website.

Modern AI assistants such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Copilot or Claude do not interpret websites like humans do.
They rely on specific, machine-readable files to understand a site’s structure, purpose, and authority.

This plugin allows you to quickly verify whether your website is exposing the key AI-readable files required for proper AI interpretation and AI-driven discoverability.

What this plugin checks

The free version verifies the presence and HTTP status of the following AI-oriented files:

  • llms.txt
  • humans.txt
  • metadata.json
  • sitemap-ia.xml
  • ai-plugin.json

Each of these files plays a specific role in how AI systems classify, interpret, and potentially reference your website.

Why this matters

If these files are missing, inaccessible, or misconfigured, AI systems may:

  • Misinterpret your website’s purpose or intent
  • Ignore relevant sections or content
  • Fail to reference or cite your site in AI-generated answers
  • Treat your website as low-confidence or generic

IASM helps you detect these issues early, before they affect your visibility in AI-powered search engines and assistants.

Who this plugin is for

  • Website owners preparing for AI-driven search
  • SEO professionals exploring Answer Engine Optimization (AEO)
  • Developers building AI-friendly web infrastructure
  • Businesses that want to future-proof their online presence

About the Premium version

IASM Free is designed as a diagnostic tool.
The Premium version allows you to generate, manage, and keep these AI-readable files updated automatically, ensuring your website remains consistently optimized for AI systems.

Developed by the team behind IA SEO Generator.

Privacy

IASM – AI Search Visibility Monitor does not collect, store, or transmit personal data.

The checks in this Free version use WordPress’ HTTP API to request your own site’s public URLs (for example: /llms.txt, /sitemap-ia.xml) to verify their HTTP status codes.

No third-party services are contacted by the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Open “IASM – AI Search Visibility Monitor” in the WordPress admin menu.
sections.faq:
Does this Free version analyze content?

No. It checks presence and HTTP status only.

Where can I get continuous monitoring?

The Pro version adds scheduled checks, alerts, history, and exportable reports.
